hosea.12.p1.b1.text: Ephraim chases the wind and pursues the east wind all day long … he makes a covenant with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.

hosea.12.p1.b2.text: In the womb he grasped his brother’s heel

hosea.12.p1.b3.text: He struggled with the angel and prevailed; he wept and sought His favor; he found Him at Bethel and spoke with Him there …

hosea.12.p1.b4.text: But you must return to your God, maintaining love and justice, and always waiting on your God.

hosea.12.p1.b5.text: A merchant loves to defraud with dishonest scales in his hands.

hosea.12.p1.b6.text: Jacob fled to the land of Aram and Israel worked for a wife— for a wife he tended sheep.

hosea.12.p1.b7.text: But by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.
